contract.raw_notes: per frame; image coords x, y in [0, 1] of the frame (x NOT pre-multiplied by width/height), hand slot 0 = signer's right hand (pose wrists decide), pose = MediaPipe pose landmarks POSE_IDX with (x, y, z; only x, y are used), face = face-mesh FACE_IDX (x, y), blend = face blendshapes in BLEND_NAMES order, NaN = not detected
contract.resample: clips longer than max_len are uniformly resampled to max_len frames
contract.normalization: x *= width/height; centre = median mid-shoulder, unit = median shoulder width (fallbacks: mean hand point, 0.3); hand xy, z, velocity, pose xy, face xy are (p - centre) / unit; hand_world * 10; NaN → 0; clip to ±10
